name: dostarlimab
uses: 1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE JEMPERLI is a programmed death receptor‑1 (PD‑1)–blocking antibody indicated: Endometrial Cancer • in combination with carboplatin and paclitaxel, followed by JEMPERLI as a single agent, for the treatment of adult patients with primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer (EC). ( 1.1 ) • as a single agent for the treatment of adult patients with mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) recurrent or advanced EC, as determined by an FDA‑authorized test, that has progressed on or following prior treatment with a platinum‑containing regimen in any setting and are not candidates for curative surgery or radiation. ( 1.1 , 2.1 ) Microsatellite Instability–High or Mismatch Repair Deficient Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer • as a single agent for the treatment of adult patients with Stage II/III, locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC) that is microsatellite instability‑high (MSI‑H) or dMMR, as determined by an FDA‑authorized test for solid tumors. ( 1.2 , 2.1 ) This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on sustained clinical complete response for 12 months. The long-term risk of relapse is unknown, with additional follow-up expected. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in a confirmatory trial(s). ( 1.2 ) Mismatch Repair Deficient Recurrent or Advanced Solid Tumors • as a single agent for the treatment of adult patients with dMMR recurrent or advanced solid tumors, as determined by an FDA‑authorized test, that have progressed on or following prior treatment and who have no satisfactory alternative treatment options.
